name: MoYu Cube Chair 3x3 (40cm)
description: The MoYu Cube Chair 3x3 is a massive (40cm) 3x3 that you can solve or use as furniture. Sit on it, use it to put your feet up, or have it in the corner as a conversation piece. We have it on good authority that it can hold up to 280lbs (see product photo 2).
